Home / House collections / Courtyard Villa

Nyumba ya Ua · 0.4 – 1.25 acre

Courtyard Villa

A villa arranged around a private court with a pool, screened from the street by two flanking wings. Guests arrive into the court; the road never touches the living rooms.

KES 32M Price band
46 wks Build time
0.4 – 1.25 acre Plot range
4/5/6 bed Plans available

Why this design

Private, inward-facing and quiet from the street.

Privacy is the whole design. Two single-storey wings frame a central double-height living block, and the only street-facing openings are high clerestory windows. Sound drops by around 15 decibels between the gate and the pool, which is the difference between a busy road and a garden.

roofs

Low-pitch standing seam metal

walls

Roughcast render and stone

openings

Sliding glass to court and pool

Included as standard
